Done. Here's what was accomplished:

**Cloned:**
- FluffOS (C++ LPMud driver) → `operations/engineering/fars/src/fluffos/`
- Discworld mudlib (LPC world library) → `operations/engineering/fars/src/discworld-mudlib/`

Both are gitignored as reference repos.

**Wrote:** `library/domains/engineering/domains/tech/domains/computing/texts/lpmud-architecture-for-agentic-systems.md`

The text covers 8 structural parallels with source-level evidence:

| MUD Pattern | 561 Equivalent | Key Insight |
|---|---|---|
| Driver/mudlib | mash-engine/harness | .spec files = MCP tool interface |
| Object lifecycle | Entity lifecycle | We lack create()/destruct() callbacks |
| Heartbeat | world_tick | MUD supports per-object intervals; we don't yet |
| call_other() | MCP tool calls | MUD tracks call origin; we should too |
| Shadows | Hooks/skills | MUD has explicit chain model; ours is implicit |
| Commands | Slash commands | MUD has pattern-based arg parsing with object resolution |
| Guilds/skills | Academy | MUD has skill trees with prerequisites; ours are flat |
| Communication | Channels/dispatch | Social points = token budgets |

The "What We Should Adopt" section has 9 concrete items prioritized by leverage — from origin tracking on tool calls (immediate) to token budgets as social points (long-term).
